system_description: Our onboarding service pulls name, skills and job titles out of uploaded resumes into a searchable database. Recruiters filter it with their own keywords; the tool does not score, rank or reject anyone.
A chat widget on a university website answers prospective students' questions about deadlines, fees and campus life. It never evaluates applications or recommends who should be admitted.
A bank's internal monitoring model looks for transaction patterns that suggest money laundering and sends cases to compliance analysts, who decide what to report.
An in-car voice assistant lets drivers ask for navigation, calls and music by speaking naturally, and answers conversationally.
A sports news site uses AI to draft match reports. An editor reads and approves every article before it goes online, and the site takes editorial responsibility for the text.
An ad agency generates photorealistic images of people who do not exist to use in banner ads, and publishes them without labels.
A motor-insurance firm uses a model to flag suspicious repair claims for manual investigation. It plays no part in setting any customer's premium or deciding who is covered.
An airport e-gate compares the face of each traveler with the photo stored in the passport they are holding, to confirm they are the same person, and opens the gate if they match.
A warehouse operator's software measures each picker's items per hour from scanner data and automatically sends warnings and schedules disciplinary meetings when a worker falls below a threshold.
A government agency's voter-help chatbot tells citizens where their polling station is and what ID to bring. It does not discuss parties or candidates.
A phone's face unlock checks that the person holding the device matches the owner's enrolled face before unlocking.
A court service uses AI to remove names and addresses from published judgments before they go online. Judges do not use it to decide cases.
A wellness app on a person's own phone estimates their mood from the tone of their voice and shows it only to them, with tips for relaxing.
A letting agency's software scores rental applicants' reliability from their credit history and declared income and recommends accepting or declining them.
A company records a convincing video of its real CEO announcing a policy that she never recorded, using AI to copy her face and voice, and shows it to staff as if she had spoken.
A hospital forecasts how many beds each ward will need next week from admission statistics, so managers can plan staffing.
